title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on the Compulsory Demolition of Illegal Buildings, Structures, and Facilities

articles.content_en:
March 27, 2013
Supreme People's Court
Reply Concerning Issues of Compulsory Demolition of Illegal Buildings, Structures, Facilities, etc.
Fa Shi [2013] No. 5
Beijing Higher People's Court:
In accordance with the spirit of the relevant provisions of the Administrative Compulsion Law and the Urban and Rural Planning Law, with respect to the compulsory demolition of illegal buildings, structures, facilities, etc. that violate the Urban and Rural Planning Law, the law has granted the administrative organ the power of compulsory execution, and the People's Court shall not accept the application for non-litigation administrative enforcement submitted by the administrative organ.
